summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by MindWalk Holdings Corp., a foreign private issuer, announcing the timing of its fourth-quarter and full fiscal year 2026 earnings release and conference call scheduled for July 22, 2026. The press release contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. It is an ordinary earnings announcement and forward-looking statements about the company's business. As a standard financial reporting update, it does not constitute a special situation.
